evidence_bearing.interpretation: Coverage and context packets record research progress but do not count as evidence-bearing support, weakening, or contradiction packets. Intended analytical relations inside case-intake packets remain inadmissible until separate receipt-backed human promotion.

packets.summary: The durable public-recovery ledger transcribes fourteen vendor candidates and records a later issue-reported count of fifteen, while preserving that the licensed 33-vendor watched roster, report method, and tier labels remain unavailable and unfrozen.
packets.allowed_language: A biased public recovery set exists and the neutral vendor denominator remains blocked. This packet may describe source custody and recovery progress only.
packets.forbidden_inference: Do not use recovered names as the market denominator or as evidence of prevalence, quality, tier, endorsement, capability, deployment, or absence.

packets.summary: A bounded Samantha Jones case-intake packet now preserves one official public-to-private transition row together with business-appointment restrictions, source-explicit ordinary explanations, AI recusal, and a separate non-retroactive 2026 consultancy-rules breach. Repository receipts, the complete public-side cohort, comparators, and claim-level human review remain missing.
packets.allowed_language: A source-addressable case intake exists and preserves both the transition row and its official counterevidence. It is not a promoted evidence packet and cannot establish a diaspora pattern.
packets.forbidden_inference: Do not count intended support relations inside the intake packet as thesis evidence, and do not use the later procedural breach to retroactively characterize the CeraCare commission.

packets.summary: A bounded institutional case-intake packet now preserves official records for separate 10DS and i.AI creation, the transfer of named digital and AI bodies into DSIT, the formation of the new GDS, collaboration among 10DS, CDDO, and i.AI, and the source-bounded refusal of a 10DS-to-i.AI succession claim. Repository receipts, institutional normalisation, comparator matching, and human review remain incomplete.
packets.allowed_language: A bounded institutional chronology and refused succession are source-addressable at intake. Collaboration and similar remit remain distinct from inheritance.
packets.forbidden_inference: Do not count the chronology as thesis support before receipt ingestion and human review, and do not convert collaboration, co-location, or similar remit into staff, budget, asset, or mandate succession.

known_gaps.description: The complete analyst-reviewed and matched synthetic-population vendor universe is not yet recovered and frozen. Fourteen public recovery candidates are durably transcribed and issue #38 reports a fifteenth, but zero memberships or tiers are confirmed from the licensed source document.
known_gaps.next_action: Obtain authorized access to Gartner document 7718657, transcribe and human-review all 33 watched vendors, method text, tier labels, and source spans, then reconcile every public claim before making cross-vendor or market-wide claims.

known_gaps.description: Two state-market case-intake packets exist, but neither has repository receipts, a complete denominator, claim-level human review, or a separate promotion decision. The other sixteen case contracts have not yet emitted durable intake packets.
known_gaps.next_action: Ingest official sources into the receipt ledger, complete cohort and institutional normalisation, conduct claim-level review, promote only admissible observations through a separate action, and build the remaining sixteen case packets.

known_gaps.description: No distinct second party has completed the adversarial selection review.
known_gaps.next_action: Record boundary attacks, alternative universes, comparator tests, and a disposition before representing the thesis program as selection-cleared.

interpretation_contract.what_this_is: A registry for proposition-scoped evidence packets and declared research gaps.
interpretation_contract.what_this_is_not: A finding, a case contract, a topology edge, a score, a completed source search, or evidence of absence.
interpretation_contract.copy_ready_caveat: An empty evidence-bearing packet set means the thesis is not yet evidenced; it does not mean the thesis is false, and it cannot be narrated as a negative result. Denominator and case-intake coverage packets describe source custody and research progress but never count as support.
